arguments.command:
cd /workspace/examples && for f in *.in.native; do
  echo "=== $f"
  /workspace/tmp/engine < $f > /tmp/out.txt 2>/tmp/err.txt
  if diff ${f/.in./.out.} /tmp/out.txt > /dev/null; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL; diff ${f/.in./.out.} /tmp/out.txt | head -10; cat /tmp/err.txt; fi
done
